gates.name: Intake
checks: Work order is well-formed against task.schema.json
At least one acceptance criterion exists
Acceptance criteria were authored by someone other than the assigned agent
Write scope is declared and within the agent's grant
Scope is one day or less

gates.name: Design
checks: Conforms to PILLARS.md
Does not appear in NON_GOALS.md
Data schema validates
No scope creep beyond the originating work order

gates.name: Code
checks: T0 static: builds with warnings as errors
T0 static: Assets/Core is engine-free
T1: all Core unit tests pass
Kernel contract tests pass
PR diff is a subset of the declared write scope
No forbidden remedy present in the diff

gates.name: Integration
checks: T2: Unity EditMode and PlayMode tests pass in batchmode
T4: no frame-budget or allocation regression against baseline

gates.name: Balance
checks: T3: simulation metrics inside the tuning envelope
No softlock detected across the seed sweep
No single dominant strategy

gates.name: Release
checks: T5: the founder played it and it is fun
Store, privacy and monetisation review
